title: ꯆꯥꯏꯅꯔꯣꯜ
title_en: Chainarol: The Ancient Code of Chivalry and Warrior Duels
author: Ancient Meitei Court Chroniclers (Traditional Puyas)
genre: Historical Treatise / Martial Code of Honor
description: The classical chivalric treatise of ancient Kangleipak recording duel codes, martial ethics, single-combat protocols, and heroic encounters between noble champions across the clans. It embodies the highest ideals of Manipuri Thang-Ta martial integrity, respectful combat, and honour unto death.
source: Royal Puya Archives of Manipur & Directorate of Language Planning
